name: Backups
description: Last run of every backup and scheduled job, UK time (hover a time for its date): Proxmox backups of prdsrv1-3 (nightly 03:30 on prx1, 02:30 on prx2), database dumps and app dumps, off-site copies from prdsrv2 (Off-site 2) and prdsrv1 (Off-site 1), property-search (4 runs a day).
templateLines: <SimpleGrid cols={{ base: 2, md: 8 }} spacing={6} verticalSpacing={6} p={4}>
<Paper key={row[0]} px={8} py={3} radius="sm" withBorder style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>

{(data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2]) ? <Tooltip label={Date.toLocaleString((data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2]).endtime * 1000, "en-GB", "Europe/London")} withArrow><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{Date.toLocaleTimeString((data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2]).endtime * 1000, "en-GB", "Europe/London").slice(0, 5)}</Text></Tooltip> : <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">none</Text>}

<Badge size="xs" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} color={(data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2])?.status === "OK" ? "green" : (data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2]) ? "red" : "gray"}>{(data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2])?.status === "OK" ? "OK" : (data[row[1]]?.data ?? []).find(task => task.id === row[2]) ? "Failed" : "None"}</Badge>
<Paper key={row[0]} px={8} py={3} radius="sm" withBorder style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>

{(data.kuma?.heartbeatList?.[row[1]] ?? []).length > 0 ? <Tooltip label={Date.toLocaleString((data.kuma.heartbeatList[row[1]])[(data.kuma.heartbeatList[row[1]]).length - 1].time.replace(" ", "T") + "Z", "en-GB", "Europe/London")} withArrow><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{Date.toLocaleTimeString((data.kuma.heartbeatList[row[1]])[(data.kuma.heartbeatList[row[1]]).length - 1].time.replace(" ", "T") + "Z", "en-GB", "Europe/London").slice(0, 5)}</Text></Tooltip> : <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">none</Text>}
{status.prx1?.ok === false || status.prx2?.ok === false || status.kuma?.ok === false ? <Text size="xs" c="red">Some sources could not be read</Text> : null}
